Wave14 registers pure tuning neighbors and selection, preserving candidate identity through the same vector. Validation callbacks used to choose parameters are tuning data rather than untouched final assessment.

The question-generation child contributes supplied selection identity, versioned schema/prompt/gate and quota/cardinality joins. Shared coordinates are the same ordered Para references, doc#para exclusions, local sentence anchors and rule value. These are distinct from lesson/benchmark IDs and do not establish question generation, persistent learning or school assessment quality. Preimages preserve omitted paragraphs and normalization ambiguity; cost is reached pure APIs.

School-support composes the question-generation child's supplied-input run/report relations: checked call-ledger preflight must reject malformed JSONL or token overflow before replacing the three existing report artifacts. The native child harness also checks retry selection/accounting and Unix metadata-error propagation. Only the reached child APIs and their bounded I/O costs are modeled; no inference-core model change, live school cycle, retention measurement, semantic accuracy claim or whole-system proof follows.
inverse: Universe comprises supplied lesson text, parsed Lessons, benchmark selection and inspected learning/reading boundaries. Exclude equating option recognition with lesson validity, arbitrary quick/medium non-nesting on the same parsed list and seed, and inferring rule-learning application from tree-reading output. These are conditional source-derived constraints, not a full school complement.

Given selected indices and parsed option tuples, retain all original lesson strings with the same parse and same selection ranks. Whitespace, comments and alternative marked positions can collapse. Selected lesson scores cannot reconstruct omitted lessons or learned state; rule candidates depend on reads, judged gold, options and rejected-rule snapshot.
Within supplied finite knob domains exclude multicoordinate/nonfinite neighbors, changed candidate indices and inadmissible selection; external adoption is outside this transition universe.

Retain every finite base map, ordered candidate list and score/callback history compatible with the selected index. Without the same retained list the index does not identify a configuration, and even with it the preceding scores/history remain ambiguous.

Universe: supplied Para/Sent/Pick/skip, versioned schema/prompt and independent TSV observations. Exclude skipped/ineligible selections, source-coordinate substitution for local p/anchors, invented labels, V2 explicit nonanchor/context spans and punctuation-changing spans. Prompt semantic constraints not enforced by the gate remain outside this complement; no acquisition/teacher behavior is inferred.

Retain every input vector, metadata, raw sentence text, Pick/skip and response sharing selected identities, prompt/gate observations and quotas. The same retained batch plus p/anchor recovers source doc/para/sent_id; gate output alone cannot. Case/quote/whitespace normalization has many raw preimages, selection loses rejected content and quotas lose weight/cap details.

Through its actual question-generation child, school-support now excludes a report collection observation that replaces any prior QA/reject/params artifact before malformed or overflowing supplied call-ledger preflight fails. The inherited boundary also excludes swallowing retry ELOOP or breaking retry/source-coordinate selection in the supplied child joins. This extension is limited to that reached child interface; it asserts nothing about school learning, retention, inference-core behavior, live training, late-write rollback or semantic answer accuracy.

At the school-support boundary retain all child question-generation run states compatible with the observed error and unchanged report bytes, or with the selected retry row and aggregate accounting. Many ledgers, discarded texts and earlier school histories remain compatible. The preflight observation identifies neither a unique learning history nor general school state, and no inverse inference-core reconstruction is supplied.
